notes.title: Update: Controller Support, New Languages, and 35% Off!
notes.content:
We're happy to introduce the latest Illuminaria update 🚀

🎮 Controller Support:  You can now enjoy Illuminaria with your favorite gamepad controller and also on the Steam Deck!

🗣️ New Languages: We've added Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, and Polish as language options. Now, more players can enjoy the game in their native tongue.

🔥 Limited-Time Offer: From October 24 to November 7, enjoy a 35% discount on Illuminaria. It's the perfect time to dive into the game and experience all these new enhancements!

Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1719240/Illuminaria/

notes.title: Update coming soon
notes.content:
Hey there!

We've got some thrilling news to share about upcoming changes to the game. Here's a quick rundown of what's coming:

[list]
[*] More Languages:  Get ready to experience Illuminaria in Traditional Chinese, Portuguese (Brazilian), Polish, Turkish, and Korean.
[*] Controller Support: We're thrilled to announce that Illuminaria will now support controllers. We think this will make the game a great fit for the Steam Deck.
[*] Refined Mechanics: Based on your feedback, we're fine-tuning gameplay mechanics for a smoother and more satisfying experience.
[*] Difficulty Adjustments: We're striving for the perfect balance of challenge and enjoyment. Prepare for a more rewarding journey!
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1719240/Illuminaria/


Stay tuned for more details as we continue to elevate Illuminaria. Thank you for joining us on this epic adventure!

notes.title: Patch 1.010
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for all the feedback, requests, and ideas.  We now have a patch with lots of changes that make Illuminaria even more fun!

Please keep sharing your comments and suggestions in our Steam community forums or on our [url=https://illuminariagame.com/discord]Discord[/url]. We appreciate your feedback!

Here's a list of the most important changes we've made.


[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Linux version now available!
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved workers AI.
[*] Balanced all difficulty levels.
[*] Changed the layout of the maps to make expeditions more available at the beginning. If you are in the middle of a game, you might notice some changes but everything should work fine.
[*] Balanced rewards in expeditions.
[*] Anti-robber turrets have a wider range.
[*] Caves are disabled until the reactor is rebuilt. 
[/list]
[h2]Quality of life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added settings for cursor confinement and edge scrolling. 
[*] Adjusted volume of sound effects.
[*] Improved golem assault screen.
[*] Improved golem potion usage.
[*] Added an icon that shows when a worker is using a potion in expedition battles.
[*] Added highlight to units and tiles in expedition battles.
[*] Added button to place all units in expedition battles.
[*] Added information about which achievements you have completed in each region.
[*] Added information about golem resistances and icons displaying its resistances.
[*] Added animations and particles to machines.
[/list]
[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed audio volume bug.
[*] Fixed edge scrolling in macOS.
[*] Fixed runes disappearing after the reactor is destroyed.
[*] Fixed resources disappearing after setting "no production" in machines.
[*] Fixed portal not appearing in monsters attack.
[*] Fixed resources not being discounted when purchasing a turret or machine.
[*] Fixed attacks without warning.
[*] Fixed turret overload not recharging when turrets were not on sight.
[*] Fixed recommended weapons in expeditions.
[*] Fixed "required" text in the expedition screen.
[/list]

Thanks again for the support! We'll keep working on the game, adding more features and making more improvements. We'll keep you posted on future news!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41311686/aa659da018b074a34cb2f9de5d2f9ffefcba05bd.png[/img]
